# Core chat regression matrix

These cases describe the behavioral contract for the existing chat orchestrator. Provider answers must be asserted against the evidence named below; customer-facing answers must not be copied into production logic. A normal grounded factual turn currently makes one interpretation request and one answer request. A standalone social turn may use its validated social path and must skip Knowledge and commerce retrieval.

| Customer message | Expected evidence | Context behavior | Provider calls | Grounding and response language |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Carteio kya hai?` | Authorized assistant identity/configuration or public business description, if available | Treat as a new business identity question | Interpretation plus one grounded answer; no commerce search | Cite only supplied business evidence; reply in Hinglish/Romanized Hindi |
| `Customer support ka contact kya hai?` | Revalidated `ASSISTANT_CONFIGURATION` evidence from validated HELP CONTACTS fields | New support contact question | Interpretation plus one grounded answer | Email/phone only if present in evidence; cite `[S#]`; reply in Hinglish |
| `Hours nahi, mujhe email aur phone chahiye.` | Recent user question and current validated support-contact evidence | Resolve as correction to the prior contact question; hours are explicitly excluded | Interpretation plus one grounded answer, no extra retry | Provide only evidenced email/phone with citation; reply in Hinglish |
| `What is the shipping policy?` | Authorized active-generation website/FAQ/policy chunk | New static business-policy question; do not request product context without evidence policy varies | Interpretation plus one grounded answer | Cite matching policy text; reply in English |
| `Carteio ki shipping kitne days ki hai?` | Relevant active-generation shipping chunk; eligible source count alone is insufficient | New question; retain Hindi/Hinglish phrasing as query context | Interpretation plus one grounded answer | State days only if present in retrieved evidence and cite; reply in Hinglish |
| `Show me your products.` | Tenant and assistant authorized Shopify catalog records | Broad catalog discovery; use commerce search only when permissions allow | Interpretation, authorized product search, and one grounded answer | Product names/details from `[C#]` records only; reply in English |
| `Is this product in stock?` | Current referenced product in conversation plus authorized catalog availability snapshot | Resolve “this” from bounded conversation; never treat prior assistant text as evidence | Interpretation, authorized product search, and one grounded answer | State snapshot time and cite `[C#]`; no claim of live inventory; reply in English |
| `Hi, how are you?` | No merchant evidence | Standalone social exchange; do not retrieve business facts | One natural social answer request; skip retrieval | No business claims or citations; reply in English |
| `Who is the prime minister?` | No merchant evidence | Unrelated general-knowledge question; redirect to assistant's business role | Interpretation plus one natural no-evidence response | Do not answer from outside knowledge; reply naturally in English |
| `What is the return window for the blue product line?` (when no matching source exists) | No relevant authorized chunk; diagnostics must distinguish eligible sources from retrieved matches | New business question; no invented source match | Interpretation plus one natural no-evidence response | State the detail cannot be confirmed; ask at most one useful follow-up; use customer language |

Existing orchestrator coverage in `assistant.playground.spec.ts` includes related end-to-end paths for grounded policy retrieval, Hinglish shipping retrieval, validated support contacts, correction/context resolution, catalog discovery, stock grounding, social turns, unrelated questions, and no-evidence uncertainty. `conversation-intent.recovery.spec.ts` covers the interpretation contract regressions directly. Runtime/provider behavior must still be verified against an authorized live merchant workspace; fixture and source tests alone do not prove production answers.
